findings.finding: Realtime pending model tool calls are cancelled before local dispatch when their parent response is cancelled/non-completed. This is useful PendingEffect cancellation, not post-submission EffectGate authority.

frank_auftrag_stellen uses a genuine mechanical proposal/confirmation gate before asynchronous task delegation: exact normalized task text, a new server-transcribed microphone utterance, <=300s age and no explicit contradiction keyword are required. The source itself admits multi-speaker/unrelated utterance ambiguity remains.

frank_erinnerung_schreiben has no analogous confirmation/admission state: non-empty model-supplied subject/value are dispatched directly to stern.py, whose exact source inserts them into the dedicated persistent gespraech_erinnerung table with source=realtime-tool.

A confirmed voice task is delegated to gespraechsmodus.claude_frage with the shared/resumed Claude session and berechtigung. Voice confirmation therefore proves only task admission; it does not prove executor-consumed authorization for each downstream effect.

triggerword4_required_design_delta: Introduce VoiceIntentEvidence separate from TaskAdmission. TaskAdmission binds task_id/request_digest/speaker-or-user-evidence/time/generation and expires; it never grants downstream state-changing effects by itself.

Introduce MemoryCandidate separate from MemoryAdmission. Every persisted conversational memory binds source utterance/event, author/model transformation class, provenance, epistemic class, privacy/retention tier and generation. A model summary/inference is never silently promoted to world fact.
Keep PendingEffect cancellation for cancelled Realtime responses, but once a candidate is SUBMITTED only EffectOutcome {SUCCEEDED,FAILED,UNKNOWN} plus re-entry evidence may close it.

Require the delegated executor/host boundary to consume a per-call EffectDecision bound to invocation_id/tool_use_id + request_digest + task_admission_id where applicable + generation + policy version + one-shot state.
Do not use one spoken task confirmation, one Claude session permission mode or one durable-memory row as a blanket capability/truth grant.
For overlapping background voice tasks, preserve immutable task identity and prevent shared-resume session state from cross-assigning effects/outcomes.
acceptance_tests_for_triggerword4: Realtime model emits frank_erinnerung_schreiben containing a model inference: row is admitted only as INFERRED/MODEL_CANDIDATE and cannot satisfy a FACT/OBSERVED query without independent evidence.
Verbatim user quote memory and model summary of the same utterance remain distinguishable by provenance and transformation class.
A cancelled Realtime response with pending tool calls produces zero local dispatches.
A second unrelated speaker utterance cannot by itself mint TaskAdmission for the original proposed action; unresolved speaker/intent becomes ASK/UNKNOWN.
Confirmed TaskAdmission followed by a downstream state-changing tool with missing/mismatched EffectDecision is denied before execution.
Two confirmed background tasks sharing one resumed Claude session retain distinct task/effect/outcome identities under interleaved completion order.
Memory privacy/retention gate rejects or redacts disallowed spoken content before durable persistence while preserving an auditable rejection receipt.

preserved_contradictions.detail: Direct Realtime model Function Calling persists conversation memory. This is compatible with EntityOS only if the storage/read path is explicitly noncanonical evidence/candidate memory or a deterministic MemoryAdmission gate prevents silent truth promotion.
The two-step voice gate is real task confirmation, but downstream per-effect enforcement remains unresolved.
Source acknowledges a second unrelated utterance can satisfy freshness if the model interprets it as approval and no keyword veto matches.

counterhypothesis: If every downstream read of gespraech_erinnerung already treats rows strictly as attributed remembered claims and every delegated Claude effect is independently host-gated, the current architecture may need metadata/schema hardening rather than a new central gate. This must be proven by end-to-end read/effect tracing, not assumed from table naming or permission prose.
next_exact_gate: Trace stern.py gespraech_erinnerung read consumers and gespraechsmodus.claude_frage -> host/settings/tool execution path. Prove whether remembered claims remain epistemically typed and whether every delegated state-changing tool consumes a per-call effect decision.
